snippet.title: Vikings on Trampolines - Official Reveal Trailer (from Owlboy Devs)
snippet.description:
Get your first look at Vikings on Trampolines, the new 4-player pixel-art co-op adventure from the makers of Owlboy whose side-scrolling gameplay mechanics revolve around – you guessed it – bouncing on trampolines. There's also a competitive party-game-style multiplayer mode as well. Vikings on Trampolines is in development for PC, and you can wishlist it now on Steam.

#IGN #Gaming
